  52def _find_project_root() -> Path:
  53    current = Path(__file__).resolve()
  54    for parent in current.parents:
  55        if (parent / "data" / "iptc_catalog.json").exists():
  56            return parent
  57    return current.parents[2]
  58

  92def send_verification_email(to_email: str, token: str) -> None:
  93    """Envía el correo de verificación de cuenta usando Gmail con contraseña de aplicación."""
  94    verification_link = f"{FRONTEND_VERIFY_URL}?token={token}"  # Ajusta la URL según tu frontend
  95
  96    msg = MIMEMultipart("alternative")
  97    msg["Subject"] = "Verifica tu cuenta - NewsRadar"
  98    msg["From"] = GMAIL_SENDER
  99    msg["To"] = to_email
 100
 101    text_body = (
 102        f"Haz clic en el siguiente enlace para verificar tu cuenta:\n"
 103        f"{verification_link}\n\nEste enlace expira en 24 horas."
 104    )
 105    html_body = f"""
 106    <html>
 107      <body style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto;">
 108        <h2>Bienvenido a NewsRadar</h2>
 109        <p>Gracias por registrarte en <strong>NewsRadar</strong>. Para completar tu registro, verifica tu cuenta haciendo clic en el botón:</p>
 110        <a href="{verification_link}"
 111           style="display:inline-block;padding:12px 24px;background:#34a853;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;border-radius:4px;font-weight:bold;">
 112          Verificar cuenta
 113        </a>
 114        <p style="margin-top:24px;color:#666;font-size:13px;">
 115          Si no realizaste este registro, ignora este correo. El enlace expira en 24 horas.
 116        </p>
 117      </body>
 118    </html>
 119    """
 120
 121    msg.attach(MIMEText(text_body, "plain"))
 122    msg.attach(MIMEText(html_body, "html"))
 123
 124    with smtplib.SMTP_SSL("smtp.gmail.com", 465) as server:
 125        server.login(GMAIL_SENDER, GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD)
 126        server.sendmail(GMAIL_SENDER, to_email, msg.as_string())

 446def sanitize_user(user: UserModel) -> User:

 451        last_name=user.last_name,
 452        organization=user.organization,

 469async def get_current_user(
 470    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security),
 471    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
 472) -> UserInDB:
 473    if credentials is None or credentials.scheme.lower() != "bearer":
 474        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Token inválido o ausente")
 475
 476    user_id = active_tokens.get(credentials.credentials)
 477    if not user_id:
 478        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Token inválido o expirado")
 479
 480    result = await db.execute(select(UserModel).where(UserModel.id == user_id))
 481    user = result.scalar_one_or_none()
 482    if not user:
 483        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Usuario inválido")
 484
 485    return user_to_db(user)

 488async def ensure_role_ids_exist(role_ids: List[int], db: AsyncSession) -> None:
 489    result = await db.execute(select(RoleModel.id).where(RoleModel.id.in_(role_ids)))
 490    existing_ids = {row[0] for row in result.fetchall()}
 491    missing = [role_id for role_id in role_ids if role_id not in existing_ids]
 492    if missing:
 493        raise HTTPException(
 494            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
 495            detail=f"Roles no encontrados: {missing}",
 496        )

 499async def create_seed_data() -> None:
 500    eng = get_engine()
 501    async with eng.begin() as conn:
 502        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
 503
 504    async with AsyncSession(eng) as db:
 505        # --- Roles (idempotente) ---
 506        result = await db.execute(select(RoleModel).where(RoleModel.name == "admin"))
 507        admin_role = result.scalar_one_or_none()
 508        if not admin_role:
 509            admin_role = RoleModel(name="admin")
 510            db.add(admin_role)
 511
 512        result = await db.execute(select(RoleModel).where(RoleModel.name == "user"))
 513        user_role = result.scalar_one_or_none()
 514        if not user_role:
 515            user_role = RoleModel(name="user")
 516            db.add(user_role)
 517
 518        await db.flush()  # asegura que los roles tienen ID antes de usarlos
 519
 520        # --- Usuarios seed (cada uno se comprueba por su cuenta) ---
 521        seed_users = [
 522            {
 523                "email": "admin@newsradar.com",
 524                "first_name": "Admin",
 525                "last_name": "NewsRadar",
 526                "organization": "NewsRadar",
 527                "password": "admin123",
 528                "role_ids": [admin_role.id],
 529            },
 530            # TODO: quitar este
 531            {

 726@app.post(f"{API_PREFIX}/users", response_model=User, status_code=201, tags=["users"])
 727async def create_user(
 728    payload: UserCreate,
 729    _: UserInDB = Depends(get_current_user),
 730    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
 731) -> User:
 732    # Case-insensitive email duplicate check
 733    result = await db.execute(select(UserModel))
 734    users = result.scalars().all()
 735    for u in users:
 736        if u.email.strip().lower() == payload.email.strip().lower():
 737            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="El email ya está registrado")
 738
 739    # XSS sanitization
 740    sanitized = {}
 741    for field in ("first_name", "last_name", "organization"):
 742        val = getattr(payload, field, None)
 743        if val:
 744            import re
 745            sanitized[field] = re.sub(r"<[^>]*>", "", val)
 746    for key, val in sanitized.items():
 747        setattr(payload, key, val)
 748
 749    # Default role_ids to gestor if empty
 750    role_ids = payload.role_ids
 751    if not role_ids:
 752        gestor_result = await db.execute(select(RoleModel))
 753        gestor_role = None
 754        for role in gestor_result.scalars().all():
 755            if role.name.strip().lower() == "gestor":
 756                gestor_role = role
 757                break
 758        role_ids = [gestor_role.id] if gestor_role else []
 759    elif len(role_ids) > 1:
 760        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Only one role allowed per user")
 761
 762    await ensure_role_ids_exist(role_ids, db)
 763
 764    data = payload.model_dump()
 765    data["role_ids"] = role_ids
 766    user = UserModel(**data)
 767    db.add(user)
 768    await db.commit()
 769    await db.refresh(user)
 770    return sanitize_user(user)
 771

 786@app.put(f"{API_PREFIX}/users/{{user_id}}", response_model=User, tags=["users"])
 787async def update_user(
 788    user_id: int,
 789    payload: UserUpdate,
 790    _: UserInDB = Depends(get_current_user),
 791    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
 792) -> User:

 794    user = result.scalar_one_or_none()
 795    if not user:
 796        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Usuario no encontrado")
 797
 798    data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
 799    if "email" in data:
 800        result = await db.execute(select(UserModel))
 801        users = result.scalars().all()
 802        for u in users:
 803            if u.id != user_id and u.email.strip().lower() == data["email"].strip().lower():
 804                raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="El email ya está registrado")
 805
 806    # XSS sanitization
 807    import re
 808    for field in ("first_name", "last_name", "organization"):
 809        if field in data and data[field]:
 810            data[field] = re.sub(r"<[^>]*>", "", data[field])
 811
 812    if "role_ids" in data:
 813        if len(data["role_ids"]) > 1:
 814            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Only one role allowed per user")
 815        await ensure_role_ids_exist(data["role_ids"], db)
 816
 817    for key, value in data.items():
 818        setattr(user, key, value)
 819
 820    await db.commit()
 821    await db.refresh(user)
 822    return sanitize_user(user)

 866async def _check_role_name(name: str) -> str:
 867    stripped = name.strip()
 868    if not stripped:
 869        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Role name cannot be empty or whitespace-only")
 870    if len(name) > 100:
 871        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Role name max length is 100")
 872    import re
 873    if re.search(r'[\x00-\x1f]', name):
 874        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Role name contains invalid characters")
 875    return stripped
 876
 877
 878async def _check_role_duplicate(db: AsyncSession, name: str, exclude_id: Optional[int] = None) -> None:
 879    result = await db.execute(select(RoleModel))
 880    roles = result.scalars().all()
 881    normalized = name.strip().lower()
 882    for role in roles:
 883        if exclude_id is not None and role.id == exclude_id:
 884            continue
 885        if role.name.strip().lower() == normalized:
 886            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Role name already exists")
 887

 978@app.post(
 979    f"{API_PREFIX}/alerts/suggest-synonyms",
 980    response_model=SuggestSynonymsResponse,
 981    tags=["alerts"],
 982)
 983async def suggest_synonyms(
 984    payload: SuggestSynonymsRequest,
 985    _: UserInDB = Depends(get_current_user),
 986    mongo_db=Depends(get_mongo_db),
 987) -> SuggestSynonymsResponse:
 988    """
 989    Sugiere sinónimos y palabras relacionadas para palabras clave.
 990
 991    Usa un diccionario manual y, si está configurado, puede completar
 992    resultados con un proveedor IA.
 993
 994    RF-02: Sugerencia automática de sinónimos durante la creación de alertas
 995    """
 996    suggested = generate_synonyms(payload.keywords, payload.max_synonyms)
 997
 998    # Guardar en diccionario cacheado (MongoDB) para reutilizar en el worker.
 999    # Solo persistimos cuando se pide sobre 1 keyword (evita mezclar sinónimos de varios temas).
1000    if len(payload.keywords) == 1:
1001        try:
1002            await upsert_synonyms(mongo_db, keyword=payload.keywords[0], synonyms=suggested, provider="api")
1003        except Exception as e:
1004            logger.warning("No se pudo actualizar keyword_dictionary: %s", str(e))
1005
1006    return SuggestSynonymsResponse(
1007        keywords=payload.keywords,
1008        suggested_synonyms=suggested,
1009    )

1087    response_model=List[Alert],
1088    tags=["alerts"],
1089)
1090async def list_user_alerts(
1091    user_id: int,
1092    _: UserInDB = Depends(get_current_user),
1093    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
1094) -> List[Alert]:
1095    result = await db.execute(select(UserModel).where(UserModel.id == user_id))
1096    if not result.scalar_one_or_none():
1097        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Usuario no encontrado")
1098
1099    result = await db.execute(select(AlertModel).where(AlertModel.user_id == user_id))
1100    alerts = result.scalars().all()
1101    return [
1102        Alert(
1103            id=a.id,
1104            user_id=a.user_id,
1105            name=a.name,
1106            descriptors=a.descriptors or [],
1107            categories=[AlertCategoryItem(**c) for c in (a.categories or [])],
1108            rss_channels_ids=a.rss_channels_ids or [],
1109            information_sources_ids=a.information_sources_ids or [],
1110            cron_expression=a.cron_expression,
1111        )
1112        for a in alerts
1113    ]
1114
1115
1116def _ensure_descriptors_range(descriptors: List[str]) -> List[str]:
1117    cleaned = []
1118    seen = set()
1119    for descriptor in descriptors:
1120        if not isinstance(descriptor, str) or not descriptor.strip():
1121            continue
1122        value = descriptor.strip()
1123        key = value.lower()
1124        if key in seen:
1125            continue
1126        cleaned.append(value)
1127        seen.add(key)
1128    if len(cleaned) > 10:
1129        return cleaned[:10]
1130    if len(cleaned) >= 3:
1131        return cleaned
1132    expanded = list(cleaned)
1133    seen = {d.lower().strip() for d in expanded}
1134    synonyms = generate_synonyms(expanded, max_synonyms=10)
1135    for s in synonyms:
1136        key = s.lower().strip()
1137        if key not in seen:
1138            expanded.append(s)
1139            seen.add(key)
1140    fallbacks = ["noticias", "actualidad", "informacion"]
1141    for fb in fallbacks:
1142        if len(expanded) >= 3:
1143            break
1144        if fb not in seen:
1145            expanded.append(fb)
1146            seen.add(fb)
1147    return expanded[:10]
1148
1149
1150def _has_duplicate_descriptors(descriptors: List[str]) -> bool:
1151    seen = set()
1152    for descriptor in descriptors:
1153        if not isinstance(descriptor, str) or not descriptor.strip():
1154            continue
1155        key = descriptor.strip().lower()
1156        if key in seen:
1157            return True
1158        seen.add(key)
1159    return False
1160
1161
1162@app.post(
1163    f"{API_PREFIX}/users/{{user_id}}/alerts",
1164    response_model=Alert,
1165    status_code=201,
1166    tags=["alerts"],
1167)
1168async def create_user_alert(
1169    user_id: int,
1170    payload: AlertCreate,
1171    _: UserInDB = Depends(get_current_user),
1172    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
1173) -> Alert:
1174    result = await db.execute(select(UserModel).where(UserModel.id == user_id))
1175    if not result.scalar_one_or_none():
1176        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Usuario no encontrado")
1177
1178    try:
1179        CronTrigger.from_crontab(payload.cron_expression)
1180    except ValueError:
1181        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Invalid cron expression")
1182
1183    existing_alerts = await db.execute(
1184        select(AlertModel).where(AlertModel.user_id == user_id)
1185    )
1186    existing_list = existing_alerts.scalars().all()
1187    if len(existing_list) >= 20:
1188        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Maximum of 20 alerts per user reached")
1189
1190    normalized_name = payload.name.strip()
1191    for existing_alert in existing_list:
1192        if existing_alert.name.strip().lower() == normalized_name.lower():
1193            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Alert name already exists for this user")
1194
1195    if len(payload.categories) > 1:
1196        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Only one category per alert is allowed")
1197
1198    seen_codes = set()
1199    for cat in payload.categories:
1200        if cat.code in seen_codes:
1201            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Duplicate categories are not allowed")
1202        seen_codes.add(cat.code)
1203        cat_result = await db.execute(
1204            select(CategoryModel).where(CategoryModel.name == cat.label)
1205        )
1206        if not cat_result.scalar_one_or_none():
1207            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"Category '{cat.label}' not found in catalog")
1208
1209    alert_data = payload.model_dump()
1210    alert_data["name"] = normalized_name
1211    alert_data["categories"] = [c.model_dump() for c in payload.categories]
1212    if _has_duplicate_descriptors(payload.descriptors):
1213        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Duplicate descriptors are not allowed")
1214    alert_data["descriptors"] = _ensure_descriptors_range(payload.descriptors)
1215    alert = AlertModel(user_id=user_id, **alert_data)
1216    db.add(alert)
1217    await db.commit()
1218    await db.refresh(alert)
1219
1220    return Alert(
1221        id=alert.id,
1222        user_id=alert.user_id,
1223        name=alert.name,
1224        descriptors=alert.descriptors or [],
1225        categories=[AlertCategoryItem(**c) for c in (alert.categories or [])],
1226        rss_channels_ids=alert.rss_channels_ids or [],
1227        information_sources_ids=alert.information_sources_ids or [],
1228        cron_expression=alert.cron_expression,
1229    )
1230

1436
1437    last_doc = await mongo_db.notifications.find_one(sort=[("_id", -1)])

1439

1449        doc["title"] = payload.title
1450    if payload.content is not None:
1451        doc["content"] = payload.content
1452    if payload.news:
1453        doc["news"] = [n.model_dump(mode="json") for n in payload.news]
1454
1455    await mongo_db.notifications.insert_one(doc)
1456
1457    return Notification(
1458        id=next_id,
1459        alert_id=alert_id,
1460        timestamp=payload.timestamp,
1461        metrics=payload.metrics,

1610
1611    result = await db.execute(select(CategoryModel))
1612    for existing in result.scalars().all():
1613        if _normalize_category_name(existing.name) == _normalize_category_name(catalog_item["name"]):
1614            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Category already exists")
1615
1616    category = CategoryModel(
1617        id=catalog_item["id"],
1618        name=catalog_item["name"],
1619        source=catalog_item["source"],
1620    )
1621    db.add(category)
1622    await db.commit()
1623    await db.refresh(category)
1624    return Category(id=category.id, name=category.name, source=category.source)

1688def _normalize_url(url: str) -> str:
1689    return url.strip().lower().rstrip("/")
1690
1691
1692async def _check_is_duplicate(db: AsyncSession, name: str, url: str, exclude_id: Optional[int] = None) -> None:
1693    result = await db.execute(select(InformationSourceModel))
1694    sources = result.scalars().all()
1695    norm_name = name.strip().lower()
1696    norm_url = _normalize_url(url)
1697    for s in sources:
1698        if exclude_id is not None and s.id == exclude_id:
1699            continue
1700        if s.name.strip().lower() == norm_name:
1701            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Information source name already exists")
1702        if _normalize_url(s.url) == norm_url:
1703            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Information source url already exists")
1704
1705
1706async def _check_rss_duplicate(db: AsyncSession, url: str, exclude_id: Optional[int] = None) -> None:
1707    result = await db.execute(select(RSSChannelModel))
1708    channels = result.scalars().all()
1709    norm_url = _normalize_url(url)
1710    for c in channels:
1711        if exclude_id is not None and c.id == exclude_id:
1712            continue
1713        if _normalize_url(c.url) == norm_url:
1714            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="RSS channel url already exists")
1715
1716
1717async def _validate_url_reachable(url: str) -> None:
1718    import ipaddress
1719    from urllib.parse import urlparse
1720
1721    parsed = urlparse(url)
1722    host = (parsed.hostname or "").lower()
1723    unreachable_markers = (
1724        ".invalid",
1725        "invalid",
1726        "inexistente",
1727        "nonexistent",
1728        "unreachable",
1729        "no-responde",
1730        "not-reachable",
1731        "/down",
1732    )
1733
1734    if parsed.scheme not in {"http", "https"} or not host:
1735        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Invalid URL")
1736
1737    url_full = f"{host}{parsed.path}"
1738
1739    if any(marker in url_full for marker in unreachable_markers):
1740        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="URL is not reachable")
1741
1742    try:
1743        host_ip = ipaddress.ip_address(host)
1744        is_local_or_private = host_ip.is_loopback or host_ip.is_private or host_ip.is_link_local
1745    except ValueError:
1746        is_local_or_private = host in {"localhost"}
1747
1748    if is_local_or_private:
1749        return
1750
1751
1752async def _validate_rss_url(url: str) -> None:
1753    import httpx
1754    import re
1755    url_lower = url.lower()
1756    if re.search(r"(/rss|/feed|\.xml|\.atom|/rss/|/atom)", url_lower):
1757        return
1758    try:
1759        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=5.0, follow_redirects=True) as client:
1760            async with client.stream("GET", url) as resp:
1761                if resp.status_code >= 500:
1762                    return
1763                ct = (resp.headers.get("content-type") or "").lower()
1764                if "xml" in ct or "rss" in ct or "+xml" in ct or "atom" in ct:
1765                    return
1766                non_rss_types = ["text/html", "application/json", "text/plain", "image/"]
1767                for t in non_rss_types:
1768                    if ct.startswith(t):
1769                        chunk = b""
1770                        async for bytes_chunk in resp.aiter_bytes():
1771                            chunk += bytes_chunk
1772                            if len(chunk) >= 2000:
1773                                break
1774                        text = chunk.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").lstrip()
1775                        if text.startswith("<?xml") or "<rss" in text[:500] or "<feed" in text[:500]:
1776                            return
1777                        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="URL does not point to an RSS/XML feed")
1778                return
1779    except HTTPException:
1780        raise
1781    except httpx.ConnectError:
1782        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="URL is not reachable or not a valid RSS feed")
1783    except Exception:
1784        return
1785
1786

 95    verification_link = f"{FRONTEND_VERIFY_URL}?token={token}"  # Ajusta la URL según tu frontend

A base class for creating Pydantic models.

Attributes:
  • __class_vars__: The names of the class variables defined on the model.
  • __private_attributes__: Metadata about the private attributes of the model.
  • __signature__: The synthesized __init__ [Signature][inspect.Signature] of the model.
  • __pydantic_complete__: Whether model building is completed, or if there are still undefined fields.
  • __pydantic_core_schema__: The core schema of the model.
  • __pydantic_custom_init__: Whether the model has a custom __init__ function.
  • __pydantic_decorators__: Metadata containing the decorators defined on the model. This replaces Model.__validators__ and Model.__root_validators__ from Pydantic V1.
  • __pydantic_generic_metadata__: A dictionary containing metadata about generic Pydantic models. The origin and args items map to the [__origin__][genericalias.__origin__] and [__args__][genericalias.__args__] attributes of [generic aliases][types-genericalias], and the parameter item maps to the __parameter__ attribute of generic classes.
  • __pydantic_parent_namespace__: Parent namespace of the model, used for automatic rebuilding of models.
  • __pydantic_post_init__: The name of the post-init method for the model, if defined.
  • __pydantic_root_model__: Whether the model is a [RootModel][pydantic.root_model.RootModel].
  • __pydantic_serializer__: The pydantic-core SchemaSerializer used to dump instances of the model.
  • __pydantic_validator__: The pydantic-core SchemaValidator used to validate instances of the model.
  • __pydantic_fields__: A dictionary of field names and their corresponding [FieldInfo][pydantic.fields.FieldInfo] objects.
  • __pydantic_computed_fields__: A dictionary of computed field names and their corresponding [ComputedFieldInfo][pydantic.fields.ComputedFieldInfo] objects.
  • __pydantic_extra__: A dictionary containing extra values, if [extra][pydantic.config.ConfigDict.extra] is set to 'allow'.
  • __pydantic_fields_set__: The names of fields explicitly set during instantiation.
  • __pydantic_private__: Values of private attributes set on the model instance.

The origin and args items map to the [__origin__][genericalias.__origin__] and [__args__][genericalias.__args__] attributes of [generic aliases][types-genericalias], and the parameter item maps to the __parameter__ attribute of generic classes.
  • __pydantic_parent_namespace__: Parent namespace of the model, used for automatic rebuilding of models.
  • __pydantic_post_init__: The name of the post-init method for the model, if defined.
  • __pydantic_root_model__: Whether the model is a [RootModel][pydantic.root_model.RootModel].
  • __pydantic_serializer__: The pydantic-core SchemaSerializer used to dump instances of the model.
  • __pydantic_validator__: The pydantic-core SchemaValidator used to validate instances of the model.

  • __pydantic_private__: Values of private attributes set on the model instance.

async def get_current_user( credentials: fastapi.security.http.HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(dependency=<fastapi.security.http.HTTPBearer object>, use_cache=True, scope=None), db: sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio.session.AsyncSession = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None)) -> UserInDB: 
470async def get_current_user(
471    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security),
472    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
473) -> UserInDB:
474    if credentials is None or credentials.scheme.lower() != "bearer":
475        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Token inválido o ausente")
476
477    user_id = active_tokens.get(credentials.credentials)
478    if not user_id:
479        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Token inválido o expirado")
480
481    result = await db.execute(select(UserModel).where(UserModel.id == user_id))
482    user = result.scalar_one_or_none()
483    if not user:
484        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Usuario inválido")
485
486    return user_to_db(user)
async def ensure_role_ids_exist( role_ids: List[int], db: sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio.session.AsyncSession) -> None: 
489async def ensure_role_ids_exist(role_ids: List[int], db: AsyncSession) -> None:
490    result = await db.execute(select(RoleModel.id).where(RoleModel.id.in_(role_ids)))
491    existing_ids = {row[0] for row in result.fetchall()}
492    missing = [role_id for role_id in role_ids if role_id not in existing_ids]
493    if missing:
494        raise HTTPException(
495            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
496            detail=f"Roles no encontrados: {missing}",
497        )
async def create_seed_data() -> None: 
500async def create_seed_data() -> None:
501    eng = get_engine()
502    async with eng.begin() as conn:
503        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
504
505    async with AsyncSession(eng) as db:
506        # --- Roles (idempotente) ---
507        result = await db.execute(select(RoleModel).where(RoleModel.name == "admin"))
508        admin_role = result.scalar_one_or_none()
509        if not admin_role:
510            admin_role = RoleModel(name="admin")
511            db.add(admin_role)
512
513        result = await db.execute(select(RoleModel).where(RoleModel.name == "user"))
514        user_role = result.scalar_one_or_none()
515        if not user_role:
516            user_role = RoleModel(name="user")
517            db.add(user_role)
518
519        await db.flush()  # asegura que los roles tienen ID antes de usarlos
520
521        # --- Usuarios seed (cada uno se comprueba por su cuenta) ---
522        seed_users = [
523            {
524                "email": "admin@newsradar.com",
525                "first_name": "Admin",
526                "last_name": "NewsRadar",
527                "organization": "NewsRadar",
528                "password": "admin123",
529                "role_ids": [admin_role.id],
530            },
531            # TODO: quitar este
532            {
533                "email": "ejemplo@newsradar.com",
534                "first_name": "ejemplo",
535                "last_name": "NewsRadar",
536                "organization": "NewsRadar",
537                "password": "adminadmin",
538                "role_ids": [admin_role.id],
539            },
540        ]
541
542        for u in seed_users:
543            result = await db.execute(
544                select(UserModel).where(UserModel.email == u["email"])
545            )
546            if result.scalar_one_or_none():
547                continue  # ya existe, saltamos
548            db.add(UserModel(**u, is_verified=True))
549
550        await db.commit()

687@app.post(f"{API_PREFIX}/auth/reset-password", response_model=VerificationResponse, tags=["auth"])
688async def reset_password(
689    payload: ResetPasswordRequest,
690    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),

698        )
699

710
711    return VerificationResponse(

714    )

@app.post(f'{API_PREFIX}/users', response_model=User, status_code=201, tags=['users'])
async def create_user( payload: UserCreate, _: UserInDB = Depends(dependency=<function get_current_user>, use_cache=True, scope=None), db: sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio.session.AsyncSession = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None)) -> User: 
727@app.post(f"{API_PREFIX}/users", response_model=User, status_code=201, tags=["users"])
728async def create_user(
729    payload: UserCreate,
730    _: UserInDB = Depends(get_current_user),
731    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
732) -> User:
733    # Case-insensitive email duplicate check
734    result = await db.execute(select(UserModel))
735    users = result.scalars().all()
736    for u in users:
737        if u.email.strip().lower() == payload.email.strip().lower():
738            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="El email ya está registrado")
739
740    # XSS sanitization
741    sanitized = {}
742    for field in ("first_name", "last_name", "organization"):
743        val = getattr(payload, field, None)
744        if val:
745            import re
746            sanitized[field] = re.sub(r"<[^>]*>", "", val)
747    for key, val in sanitized.items():
748        setattr(payload, key, val)
749
750    # Default role_ids to gestor if empty
751    role_ids = payload.role_ids
752    if not role_ids:
753        gestor_result = await db.execute(select(RoleModel))
754        gestor_role = None
755        for role in gestor_result.scalars().all():
756            if role.name.strip().lower() == "gestor":
757                gestor_role = role
758                break
759        role_ids = [gestor_role.id] if gestor_role else []
760    elif len(role_ids) > 1:
761        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Only one role allowed per user")
762
763    await ensure_role_ids_exist(role_ids, db)
764
765    data = payload.model_dump()
766    data["role_ids"] = role_ids
767    user = UserModel(**data)
768    db.add(user)
769    await db.commit()
770    await db.refresh(user)
771    return sanitize_user(user)

async def create_user_alert( user_id: int, payload: AlertCreate, _: UserInDB = Depends(dependency=<function get_current_user>, use_cache=True, scope=None), db: sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio.session.AsyncSession = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None)) -> Alert: 
1163@app.post(
1164    f"{API_PREFIX}/users/{{user_id}}/alerts",
1165    response_model=Alert,
1166    status_code=201,
1167    tags=["alerts"],
1168)
1169async def create_user_alert(
1170    user_id: int,
1171    payload: AlertCreate,
1172    _: UserInDB = Depends(get_current_user),
1173    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
1174) -> Alert:
1175    result = await db.execute(select(UserModel).where(UserModel.id == user_id))
1176    if not result.scalar_one_or_none():
1177        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Usuario no encontrado")
1178
1179    try:
1180        CronTrigger.from_crontab(payload.cron_expression)
1181    except ValueError:
1182        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Invalid cron expression")
1183
1184    existing_alerts = await db.execute(
1185        select(AlertModel).where(AlertModel.user_id == user_id)
1186    )
1187    existing_list = existing_alerts.scalars().all()
1188    if len(existing_list) >= 20:
1189        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Maximum of 20 alerts per user reached")
1190
1191    normalized_name = payload.name.strip()
1192    for existing_alert in existing_list:
1193        if existing_alert.name.strip().lower() == normalized_name.lower():
1194            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Alert name already exists for this user")
1195
1196    if len(payload.categories) > 1:
1197        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Only one category per alert is allowed")
1198
1199    seen_codes = set()
1200    for cat in payload.categories:
1201        if cat.code in seen_codes:
1202            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Duplicate categories are not allowed")
1203        seen_codes.add(cat.code)
1204        cat_result = await db.execute(
1205            select(CategoryModel).where(CategoryModel.name == cat.label)
1206        )
1207        if not cat_result.scalar_one_or_none():
1208            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"Category '{cat.label}' not found in catalog")
1209
1210    alert_data = payload.model_dump()
1211    alert_data["name"] = normalized_name
1212    alert_data["categories"] = [c.model_dump() for c in payload.categories]
1213    if _has_duplicate_descriptors(payload.descriptors):
1214        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Duplicate descriptors are not allowed")
1215    alert_data["descriptors"] = _ensure_descriptors_range(payload.descriptors)
1216    alert = AlertModel(user_id=user_id, **alert_data)
1217    db.add(alert)
1218    await db.commit()
1219    await db.refresh(alert)
1220
1221    return Alert(
1222        id=alert.id,
1223        user_id=alert.user_id,
1224        name=alert.name,
1225        descriptors=alert.descriptors or [],
1226        categories=[AlertCategoryItem(**c) for c in (alert.categories or [])],
1227        rss_channels_ids=alert.rss_channels_ids or [],
1228        information_sources_ids=alert.information_sources_ids or [],
1229        cron_expression=alert.cron_expression,
1230    )

1359    user_id: int,
1360    alert_id: int,
1361    _: UserInDB = Depends(get_current_user),
1362    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
1363    mongo_db=Depends(get_mongo_db),
1364) -> List[Notification]:
1365    result = await db.execute(
1366        select(AlertModel).where(AlertModel.id == alert_id, AlertModel.user_id == user_id)
1367    )
1368    if not result.scalar_one_or_none():
1369        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Alerta no encontrada para el usuario")
1370
1371    cursor = mongo_db.notifications.find({"alert_id": alert_id})
1372    notifications = await cursor.to_list(length=None)
1373
1374    if not notifications:
1375        news_docs = await mongo_db.news.find({"alert_id": alert_id}).sort("created_at", -1).to_list(length=200)
1376        if news_docs:
1377            notifications = [
1378                {
1379                    "_id": 1,
1380                    "alert_id": alert_id,
1381                    "timestamp": news_docs[0].get("created_at") or datetime.now(timezone.utc),
1382                    "metrics": [
1383                        {"name": "articles_detected", "value": len(news_docs)},
1384                        {"name": "articles_stored", "value": len(news_docs)},
1385                    ],
1386                    "title": "Noticias detectadas",
1387                    "content": f"Se detectaron {len(news_docs)} noticias.",
1388                    "news": [
1389                        {
1390                            "title": item.get("title") or "Sin titulo",
1391                            "link": item.get("url") or "#",
1392                            "source_name": item.get("source_name") or item.get("source_origin") or "Fuente desconocida",
1393                            "category": item.get("category") or item.get("iptc_category") or "Sin categoria",
1394                            "published": item.get("published_date"),
1395                            "description": item.get("description") or "",
1396                        }
1397                        for item in news_docs
1398                    ],
1399                }
1400            ]
1401
1402    return [
1403        Notification(
1404            id=n["_id"],
1405            alert_id=n["alert_id"],
1406            timestamp=n["timestamp"],
1407            metrics=[Metric(**m) for m in n.get("metrics", [])],
1408            title=n.get("title"),
1409            content=n.get("content"),
1410            news=[NewsRef(**x) for x in n.get("news", [])],
1411        )
1412        for n in notifications
1413    ]

1431) -> Notification:
1432    result = await db.execute(

1438    last_doc = await mongo_db.notifications.find_one(sort=[("_id", -1)])

1455
1456    await mongo_db.notifications.insert_one(doc)
1457
1458    return Notification(

@app.post(f'{API_PREFIX}/categories', response_model=Category, status_code=201, tags=['categories'])
async def create_category( payload: CategoryCreate, _: UserInDB = Depends(dependency=<function get_current_user>, use_cache=True, scope=None), db: sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio.session.AsyncSession = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None)) -> Category: 
1597@app.post(f"{API_PREFIX}/categories", response_model=Category, status_code=201, tags=["categories"])
1598async def create_category(
1599    payload: CategoryCreate,
1600    _: UserInDB = Depends(get_current_user),
1601    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
1602) -> Category:
1603    data = payload.model_dump()
1604    catalog_item = IPTC_CATALOG_BY_NAME.get(_normalize_category_name(data["name"]))
1605    if not catalog_item:
1606        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Category is not in IPTC catalog")
1607
1608    result = await db.execute(select(CategoryModel).where(CategoryModel.id == catalog_item["id"]))
1609    if result.scalar_one_or_none():
1610        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Category already exists")
1611
1612    result = await db.execute(select(CategoryModel))
1613    for existing in result.scalars().all():
1614        if _normalize_category_name(existing.name) == _normalize_category_name(catalog_item["name"]):
1615            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Category already exists")
1616
1617    category = CategoryModel(
1618        id=catalog_item["id"],
1619        name=catalog_item["name"],
1620        source=catalog_item["source"],
1621    )
1622    db.add(category)
1623    await db.commit()
1624    await db.refresh(category)
1625    return Category(id=category.id, name=category.name, source=category.source)

2101@app.post(f"{API_PREFIX}/stats", response_model=Stats, status_code=201, tags=["stats"])

2103    payload: StatsCreate,
2104    _: UserInDB = Depends(get_current_user),
2105    mongo_db=Depends(get_mongo_db),
2106) -> Stats:
2107    # Get next ID
2108    last_doc = await mongo_db.stats.find_one(sort=[("_id", -1)])
2109    next_id = (last_doc["_id"] + 1) if last_doc else 1
2110
2111    doc = {
2112        "_id": next_id,
2113        "metrics": [m.model_dump() for m in payload.metrics],
2114    }
2115    await mongo_db.stats.insert_one(doc)
2116
2117    return Stats(id=next_id, metrics=payload.metrics)
